name: twp-block
description: Multi-sided test block, 120x80x50: four work planes (top face, a 30 degree facet, a compound facet at azimuth 27 / tilt 38, and the front face rolled 90 degrees), 16 operations: facing, adaptive pocket, drilling, helixes, a 20 degree angled hole, profile with Lead In/Out, deburr, engrave text, slot. The job uses a 5-axis AC-trunnion machine (the .fcm files are its machine definitions). twp_test_block_model.py rebuilds the model from scratch.

name: class-tray
description: The CAM 101 class tray: a rounded-rectangle tray with a pocket, roughed and finished with multi-pass Profile, a start point, Lead In/Out and dressups. A has no work plane; B is the same job with a work plane on the top face (their world toolpaths should be identical).

name: pocket-island
description: 120x70x20 block with a 40x40x8 pocket around a round island, plus a through hole. 'variants' has 26 operations covering every Pocket clearing pattern, finishing passes / offset / one-step-down / helix ramp, Profile multi-pass, ramp methods, finishing and StartAt, and MillFace. 'job-only' is the same Job with no operations (build your own). 'saved-by-pre30402' was saved by FreeCAD before PR #30402 (ZigZagOffset pockets, MinTravel with a start point): use it to test how old files migrate.

name: avoid-faces
description: Planar Surface test parts: an 80x60x20 block with a 20x20x5 pad whose top face is avoided (Avoid Last X Faces = 1), and a pocket floor with vertical walls.
